# Research Report Title

## Scope and provenance

State the research date, source revisions, method, and limits. Distinguish source
review, recovered discussion, engineering judgment, and executed experiments.

## Findings and design options

## Decision status and qualification

Link to accepted authority and open decisions. Research is evidence, not an
implementation admission or a competing architecture contract.

## Evidence and sources

## Limitations and remaining questions
